description:
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
SHERIFF'S SALE
26000437
SUPERIOR COURT
OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
DOCKET NO. F00863824
WILMINGTON TRUST, NATIONAL
ASSOCIATION, AS TRUSTEE FOR
THE BENEFIT OF THE REGISTERED
HOLDERS OF COMM 2014-UBS4
MORTGAGE TRUST COMMERCIAL
MORTGAGE PASS-THROUGH
CERTIFICATES, BY AND THROUGH
ITS SPECIAL SERVICER LNR PARTNERS, LLC, is the Plaintiff, and H'Y2 KNIGHTSBRIDGE, LLC, ET ALS., are
Defendants, writ of execution for
the sale of mortgaged premises
dated 04/30/2025.
By virtue of the above stated Writ,
to me directed and delivered, I will
expose to sale at public vendue on
WEDNESDAY, the 6TH DAY of MAY
A.D. 2026, at the hour of one thirty o'
clock by the then prevailing
(Standard or Daylight Saving) time,
in the afternoon of the said day, at
the Heldrich Hotel, 10 Livingston
Ave, New Brunswick, N.J. 08901.
The property to be sold is located
in the PISCATAWAY TOWNSHIP in the County of
MIDDLESEX, and State of New Jersey.
Commonly known as: 30 Knightsbridge Road;
Tax Lat: 4.02, Tax Block: 6201.
Dimensions of the Property:
15.76 acres or 686,316 square feet.
Nearest Cross Street: Erricson Drive.
Upset Price: the full judgment
amount as of May 1, 2026 of
$57,052,864.41 + post judgment
interest thereafter.
Type of Property: Commercial property consisting of four buildings, 686,316 square feet, and a parking lot.
SURPLUS MONEY: if after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses,
there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and
any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and
4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing
payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information
regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount of the
upset to be satisfied by said sale is
the sum of FIFTY FIVE MILLION
EIGHT HUNDRED THIRTY EIGHT
THOUSAND THREE DOLLARS AND
FORTY TWO CENTS
($55,838,003.42) dollars more or
less, plus interest together with the
costs of this sale. THE UPSET
AMOUNT MAY BE SUBJECT TO
FURTHER ORDERS OF ADDITIONAL SUMS.
The subscriber reserves the right to
adjourn said sale from time to time
subject only to such limitations or
restrictions upon the exercise of
such power as may be specially
provided by law or rules of the
Court. Sold subject to conditions of sale.
Successful bidder must pay 20% of
bid in certified check or official
bank check at close of sale and the
balance in two weeks.
Mildred S. Scott, Sheriff
Attorney:
MCCARTER & ENGLISH, LLP
100 MULBERRY STREET
FOUR GATEWAY CENTER
NEWARK, NJ 07102
Dated: 4/7, 4/14, 4/21, 4/28/2026
